title: Trait-set inconsistency: DecodedBlock derives Clone+PartialEq; DecodedPart derives neither
description:
## Finding

uuencoding/src/lib.rs:
  #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
  pub struct DecodedBlock { ... }
  
  #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
  pub struct BlockMetadata { ... }
  
  #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
  pub struct ScannedBlock { ... }

yencoding/src/lib.rs:
  #[derive(Debug)]
  #[cfg_attr(feature = "serde", derive(serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize))]
  pub struct DecodedPart { ... }
  
  #[derive(Debug)]
  #[cfg_attr(feature = "serde", derive(serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize))]
  pub struct YencMetadata { ... }

## Impact

A caller that wants to clone a DecodedPart (e.g. to store the most recently decoded part while processing a stream) or compare two DecodedPart values in tests cannot do so without manual copying. yencoding-multi's assembler.rs test code constructs DecodedPart values by hand in test helpers; those could use Clone if it were available. Any future crate in this workspace that stores decoded results uniformly must treat the two decode-result types differently.
